Client-ID und API-Key erhältst du kosten: Get your Client-ID and API key for free at developers.deutschebahn.com: create an application and subscribe it to OpenBoards and OpenStation with the Free plan.
Die DB ersetzt die Timetables-API durch: DB is replacing the Timetables API with OpenBoards and no longer accepts new subscriptions for it. Only choose Timetables while your application is not yet subscribed to OpenBoards.
Pro Station wird meist 1 Aufruf je Inter: Each station usually uses 1 request per interval (Timetables: 2-3 requests, Free plan max. 60/minute).
